records.failureSummary:
Added/confirmed focused unit tests in test/render.test.mjs (new file only) covering FR-2 normalization and FR-3 column-width/padding as consumed through renderTable in src/render.mjs. Ten tests are named with their AC numbers ([AC-01]..[AC-10]) and cover: newline to
in header and data cells; pipe escaped as \| in header and data cells; trim of leading/trailing whitespace; combined order on ' a\nb | c ' (newline, then pipe escape, then trim); width = max(3, max normalized length including header); minimum width 3 for short content; a wide data cell driving the width; normalized (not raw) content driving width; right-padding of every column including the last; header-only tables with empty rows producing viable widths. Full suite passed: 11 tests, 11 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors. Since pnpm is not installed in this sandbox (pnpm: not found, exit 127), I ran the equivalent npm test which executes the identical node --test script. Red-light evidence: running the same 10 tests against the original unimplemented renderTable stub (built out-of-tree, workspace untouched) produced 0 passed / 10 failed, proving the tests are non-vacuous and would fail before the implementation. npm run build and npm run lint both pass (node --check clean). No product code was modified; git status shows only the new untracked test/render.test.mjs plus the pre-existing backend T4 change to src/render.mjs.
